ground_truth.title: [C-01] Using Uniswap spot price is subject to manipulation
ground_truth.description: UniswapModule.getInputPositionValue() and getOutputPositionValue() call the Uniswap V3 quoter with the configured path, so the returned token-to-USDC values are based on the pools' current state rather than a manipulation-resistant reference. ModularSwapRouter forwards these quotes into ERC20 amount conversions and total position valuation. A flash loan or large trade can temporarily skew the pool state before the quote is consumed, causing the margin system to perform its collateral and debt calculations using a manipulated price.
ground_truth.impact: An attacker can cause withdrawal, borrowing, liquidation, and debt-clearing checks to use an incorrect base-token value, potentially allowing favorable asset extraction or leaving other users' positions with bad debt and causing losses to other users.
ground_truth.mitigation: Use Chainlink oracles to price supported assets instead of the Uniswap V3 quoter's current spot quote.
